notes.title: 1.4 UPDATE
notes.notes:
The 1.4 is here and the game can run on steamdeck.

I made several changes to B-plan (second story mode)
-a new cutscene
-some texts re-written
-some timings revisions during levels 

The sound test is functional and all the ost can be listened here...

I made a new weapon set, the Jigunapachi (aviable in the training section, it needs balance )



I know there could be some mispelling and gamatical mistakes, I'm working on it and sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: hotfix
notes.notes: ending bug, now it can be skipped and brings the players to the final screen where they can enters their names.

notes.title: bug fix
notes.notes: little bugs during the first bonus stage (fixed)

notes.title: 1.3 UPDATE
notes.notes:
A new set of stages is aviable as "B-plan" (breakforce plan) it can be selected in the menu.

-Mode selection has been remade
-The 1rst and second stage are variations of the original levels but next ones are brand new.
-Continues are now set to 9, but I hope you'll try to beat the game with only one (this is possible)
-new weapon sets have been added (moon dancer and surgeon gear)

I hope you'll have fun!

notes.title: stage2 update
notes.notes: the second stage midboss was set in "noshot mode" this is repaired now.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
Thanks for the feedback (private or in the community HUB).

In arcade mode at the end of 4th stage, when the player touches the green cristal after the boss the player ship explodes.... this is now fixed!

notes.title: 25/06/23 update
notes.notes:
Arcade secret stage (ending) was leading to story mode, it's fixed !

Little fix done on last boss (greenmode)

notes.title: Update !!! I can hear you !!!!
notes.notes:
I've change the font in the game, the previous was pretty and stylish but unreadable, I must admit.

fixed the hud at the top of the screen (the green hyper bar was bugged)

some minor changes and some more corrections again, thanks to luggage (Verisim Skies on steam) he helped me a lot!

I'm continuing to build new levels (the "routeB" project) they'll come later, just be patient!

Thank you for playing NANOFORCE if there are bugs or anything else just tell me!

notes.notes:
all is in the title, thank you all for your purchase and for your playing !
I know the game is hard but try hard, the best score will be awarded by new levels and alternative endings !
